# ToolsKaro

> Free in-browser tools for Indian exam and government job applicants. Resize and compress photos and signatures to an exact KB/size, convert and edit PDFs, build resumes and biodata, and run everyday calculators. All processing happens locally in the browser — no uploads, no signup, no watermark.

ToolsKaro is crafted and maintained by AdMatrix Media (https://www.linkedin.com/company/admatrix-media); editorial and product direction by Narender Chaudhary. Every tool is free, works on mobile, and never uploads your files to a server.

## Tool hubs (categories)
- [Image Tools](https://toolskaro.com/image-tools/): All photo and signature tools — compress, resize, passport photo, remove background, convert.
- [PDF Tools](https://toolskaro.com/pdf-tools/): Full PDF toolkit — merge, split, compress, convert, rotate, organize.
- [Document Makers](https://toolskaro.com/document-tools/): Resume, marriage biodata, cover letter and GST invoice makers.
- [Calculators](https://toolskaro.com/calculators/): EMI, SIP, GST, interest, percentage, CGPA, age and TDEE calculators.
- [Utility Tools](https://toolskaro.com/utilities/): Typing test, QR generator, word counter, password generator and more.

## Image tools
- [Image Compressor](https://toolskaro.com/image-compressor/): Compress JPG/PNG to an exact KB (20, 50, 100 KB) for exam portals.
- [Image Resizer](https://toolskaro.com/image-resizer/): Resize images to exact pixel dimensions, with passport/signature presets.
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://toolskaro.com/passport-photo-maker/): White-background passport-size photo (3.5×4.5 cm, 2×2 in).
- [Signature Resize](https://toolskaro.com/signature-resize/): Resize a signature to the size and KB exam forms require.
- [Remove Background](https://toolskaro.com/remove-background/): In-browser AI background removal to a transparent PNG.
- [Crop Image](https://toolskaro.com/crop-image/): Crop with drag-select or aspect-ratio presets.
- [Image Converter](https://toolskaro.com/image-converter/): Convert between PNG, JPG and WebP.
- [Photo + Signature Combiner](https://toolskaro.com/photo-signature-combiner/): Combine photo and signature into one image.
- [Photo Joiner](https://toolskaro.com/photo-joiner/): Combine photos side by side, stacked or in a grid.
- [Social Media Image Resizer](https://toolskaro.com/social-media-image-resizer/): Exact sizes for Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Pinterest.
- [JPEG to JPG Converter](https://toolskaro.com/jpeg-to-jpg/): Convert JPEG (or PNG/WebP) to a JPG file in the browser.
- [PNG to JPG Converter](https://toolskaro.com/png-to-jpg/): Convert PNG to a smaller JPG, transparency flattened to white.
- [Resize Image in KB](https://toolskaro.com/resize-image-in-kb/): Reduce a photo to an exact KB size (20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB or any target).
- [Increase Image Size in KB](https://toolskaro.com/increase-image-size-in-kb/): Increase a photo's file size to a minimum KB for forms that require a minimum.
- [Resize Image in CM](https://toolskaro.com/resize-image-in-cm/): Resize a photo to exact centimetres at a chosen DPI (e.g. 3.5×4.5 cm at 300 DPI).
- [Change Image DPI](https://toolskaro.com/change-image-dpi/): Set a photo's DPI (e.g. 300 DPI) for exam forms and printing.
- [WhatsApp DP Resizer](https://toolskaro.com/resize-image-for-whatsapp-dp/): Square-crop and resize a photo for a WhatsApp display picture.
- [PAN Card Photo](https://toolskaro.com/resize-for-pan-card/): Resize and compress a photo & signature for a PAN card application.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://toolskaro.com/heic-to-jpg/): Convert iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos to standard JPG, no watermark.
- [HEIC to PDF](https://toolskaro.com/heic-to-pdf/): Convert iPhone HEIC photos into one PDF.
- [WebP to JPG](https://toolskaro.com/webp-to-jpg/): Convert WebP images to JPG.
- [WebP to PDF](https://toolskaro.com/webp-to-pdf/): Convert WebP images into one PDF.

## Document use-case pages
- [Compress PDF for USCIS](https://toolskaro.com/compress-pdf-for-uscis/): Reduce documents below the myUSCIS upload limit.
- [Compress Resume PDF](https://toolskaro.com/compress-resume-pdf/): Shrink a CV to fit a job-portal or email limit.
- [Combine Bank Statements into PDF](https://toolskaro.com/combine-bank-statements-pdf/): Merge monthly statements into one PDF.
- [Reduce PDF Size for Visa Application](https://toolskaro.com/reduce-pdf-size-for-visa-application/): Compress documents below a visa portal limit.

## PDF tools
- [JPG to PDF](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/jpg-to-pdf/): Combine images into one PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert PDF pages to JPG images.
- [Merge PDF](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/merge/): Combine multiple PDFs into one.
- [Compress PDF](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/compress/): Reduce PDF file size for uploads.
- [Compress PDF to 100 KB](https://toolskaro.com/compress-pdf-to-100kb/): Get a PDF under a 100 KB limit.
- [Compress PDF to 200 KB](https://toolskaro.com/compress-pdf-to-200kb/): Get a PDF under a 200 KB limit.
- [Compress PDF to 300 KB](https://toolskaro.com/compress-pdf-to-300kb/): Get a PDF under a 300 KB limit.
- [Compress PDF to 500 KB](https://toolskaro.com/compress-pdf-to-500kb/): Get a PDF under a 500 KB limit.
- [Compress PDF to 1 MB](https://toolskaro.com/compress-pdf-to-1mb/): Get a PDF under a 1 MB limit.
- [Compress PDF to 2 MB](https://toolskaro.com/compress-pdf-to-2mb/): Get a PDF under a 2 MB limit.
- [Split PDF](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/split/): Extract pages or split into separate files.
- [Rotate PDF](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/rotate/): Rotate pages 90/180/270°.
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/delete-pages/): Remove pages from a PDF.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/page-numbers/): Number PDF pages in any position.
- [Watermark PDF](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/watermark/): Add a text watermark to every page.
- [Organize PDF](https://toolskaro.com/pdf/organize/): Reorder, rotate and delete pages with thumbnails.
- [Resize PDF](https://toolskaro.com/resize-pdf/): Fit every page to A4, Letter, Legal, A5 or A3 page size.

## Documents
- [Resume / CV Maker](https://toolskaro.com/resume-maker/): Build a resume and export to PDF.
- [Marriage Biodata Maker](https://toolskaro.com/marriage-biodata-maker/): Hindi & English marriage biodata to PDF.
- [Cover Letter Generator](https://toolskaro.com/cover-letter-generator/): Professional cover letter to PDF.
- [Invoice Generator](https://toolskaro.com/invoice-generator/): GST invoice maker, export to PDF.
- [Email Signature Maker](https://toolskaro.com/email-signature-maker/): Create a professional email signature with photo, designation, company and social icons; copy to Gmail or Outlook.

## Calculators
- [EMI Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/emi-calculator/): Home, car and personal loan EMI.
- [SIP Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/sip-calculator/): Mutual fund SIP returns.
- [GST Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/gst-calculator/): Add or remove GST with CGST/SGST split.
- [Interest Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/interest-calculator/): Simple and compound interest.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/percentage-calculator/): Percentage, of, increase/decrease.
- [Marks % & CGPA Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/marks-percentage-calculator/): Marks percentage and CGPA ↔ percentage.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/tdee-calculator/): Total Daily Energy Expenditure and BMR, with daily calorie targets to lose, maintain or gain weight.
- [Pregnancy Due Date Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/pregnancy-calculator/): Estimated due date and week-by-week pregnancy tracker from LMP, conception or IVF transfer date.

## Utilities
- [Age Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/age-calculator/): Exact age and age-as-on exam cut-off date.
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolskaro.com/qr-code-generator/): Make a QR code from any link or text.
- [Word Counter](https://toolskaro.com/word-counter/): Count words, characters and reading time.
- [Typing Test](https://toolskaro.com/typing-test/): English and Hindi typing speed test (WPM).
- [Password Generator](https://toolskaro.com/password-generator/): Strong random passwords.
- [Text Case Converter](https://toolskaro.com/text-case-converter/): UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case and more.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://toolskaro.com/date-difference-calculator/): Days between two dates.

- [Compress image to 50 KB](https://toolskaro.com/compress-image-to-50kb/): The common 50 KB photo limit for SSC, UPSC and state PSC forms.
- [Photo & signature for SSC CGL](https://toolskaro.com/photo-resize-for-ssc-cgl/): Photo and signature requirements for the SSC CGL form.
- [Photo & signature for IBPS PO](https://toolskaro.com/photo-resize-for-ibps-po/): Bank exam photo and signature requirements.
- [Photo & signature for UPSC](https://toolskaro.com/photo-resize-for-upsc/): UPSC Civil Services photo and signature requirements.
